name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details in high-motion scenes better than standard upscalers, which directly boosts output quality without extra compute. The trade-off is a slight slowdown—depth-aware upscaling adds 5-10% runtime—but the quality gain outweighs the cost for most use cases.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core problem isn’t resolution—it’s motion blur and temporal inconsistency. Flowframes’ VFI won’t fix it either; it masks motion but doesn’t restore lost facial detail. Test a face-specific temporal super-resolution model like FOMM or Temporally Consistent Face Video Editing instead—if it improves fidelity by 0.5%+ without breaking the pipeline, that’s the call.
